theorems.name: Submission.dimred_cs_st_tangent_sub_of_ball_ratio
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (R : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n) (z : Euclid P), (∀ X : Euclid P → Euclid P, ContDiff ℝ 1 X → HasCompactSupport X → R.firstVariation X = 0) → (∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → R.measure (closedBall z ρ) = ENNReal.ofReal (ρ ^ n) * R.measure (closedBall z 1)) → ∀ᵐ x ∂R.measure, (approxTangentPlane n R.carrier x).starProjection (x - z) = x - z
